content: Sɔ̃ɔ teeru Dɑfidi u tɑbu kowobu nɔrɔm nɔrɔm kɑ wunɔm wunɔm wiruɡibu mɛnnɑ kɑ sere mɑɑ wiruɡii be bɑ tie.

Mɑ u be kpuro sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, yeni yɑ̀ n ween nɑ Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinnin min di, mɑ yɑ bɛɛ wɛ̃re, i de su sɔmɔbu ɡɔri bɛsɛɡibun mi Isirelin tem kpuro sɔɔ, yɑ̃ku kowobu kɑ Lefibɑn mi be bɑ wɑ̃ɑ wuu mɑrosɔ kɑ kpɑrɑ yenɔ kpɑ bu mɛnnɑmɑ.
Kpɑ su kɑ Gusunɔ bɛsɛn Yinnin woodɑn kpɑkoro te wurɑmɑ. Domi sɑ ǹ ten ɡɑri kue Sɔɔlun wɑɑti sɔɔ.
Mɑ tɔn be kpuro bɑ wurɑ bu ko mɛ. Domi ɡɑri yi, yi kɑ bu nɑɑwɑ.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u Isirelibɑ kpuro mɛnnɑ sɑɑ Sikorin di ye yɑ wɑ̃ɑ Eɡibitiɔ sere kɑ Hɑmɑtin duu yerɔ kpɑ bu dɑ bu Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkoro te suɑmɑ Kiriɑti Yɑrimun di.

Yerɑ Dɑfidi u seewɑ kɑ Isireli be kpuro bɑ dɑ Bɑɑlɑɔ ye bɑ mɑɑ mɔ̀ Kiriɑti Yɑrimu, Yudɑn temɔ, bu kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkoro te tɑmɑ, tèn wuswɑɑɔ bɑ rɑ Yinni Gusunɔn yĩsiru soku, wi u rɑ n sɔ̃ ten wɔllɔ wɔllun kɔ̃sobun suunu sɔɔ.
Mɑ bɑ tu suɑ bɑ doke nɑɑ kɛkɛ kpɑɑ ɡɑɑ sɔɔ bɑ kɑ doonɑ Aminɑdɑbun yɛnun di. Usɑ kɑ Akiyowɑ bɑ nɑɑ kɛkɛ ye kpɑre.
Mɑ Dɑfidi kɑ Isirelibɑ kpuro bɑ bu swĩi bɑ mɔrɔkunu soomɔ kɑ ɡɔ̃ɔɡenu, kɑ bɑrɑ kpɑ̃nu, kɑ sɛkɛtirɛnu, kɑ yɑnkokonu. Mɑ bɑ womusu mɔ̀ bɑ yɑɑmɔ kɑ ben dɑm kpuro bɑ kɑ Gusunɔ sɑ̃ɑmɔ.
Sɑɑ yè sɔɔ bɑ turɑ Kidonin doo soo yerɔ, yerɑ kpɑkoro te, tɑ wɔrumɑɑ dɔɔ, mɑ Usɑ u nɔmɑ dɛmiɑ u tu ɡɑbɑ.
Mii mii, Yinni Gusunɔ u kɑ nùn mɔru kuɑ. Mɑ u derɑ u wɔrumɑ kpɑkoro ten bɔkuɔ u ɡu, yèn sɔ̃ u tu bɑbɑ.
Dɑfidi u mɔru kuɑ too yèn sɔ̃ Yinni Gusunɔ u kɑ Usɑ sɛɛyɑsiɑ mɛ. Mɑ u yɑm mi yĩsiru kɑ̃ Perɛsi Usɑ. Yen tubusiɑnɑ Usɑn ɡoo yeru. Yĩsi terɑ bɑ kɑ mu sokumɔ sere kɑ ɡisɔn ɡisɔ.
Mɑ Dɑfidi u Yinni Gusunɔ nɑsiɑ dɔmɑ te. Yerɑ n derɑ u kɑ nɛɛ, ɑmɔnɑ u koo ko u kɑ Yinni Gusunɔn woodɑn kpɑkoro te turi win yɛnuɔ.
U ǹ dere bu ɡinɑ kɑ tu dɑ win yɛnuɔ Yerusɑlɛmuɔ. U derɑ bɑ kɑ tu dɑwɑ Obɛdi Edɔmu Gɑtiɡiin yɛnuɔ.
Mɑ tɑ kuɑ mi suru itɑ. Mɑ Yinni Gusunɔ u durɔ wi kɑ win yɛnuɡibu kɑ mɑɑ ye u mɔ kpuro domɑru kuɑ.
